questions.stem: 在創客空間（makerspace）裡，昂貴的設備由所有會員共用，這讓人人都有機會把創意變成發明。
questions.answer: In a makerspace, expensive equipment is shared by all members, which gives everyone a chance to turn creative ideas into inventions.
accepted_answers: In makerspaces, expensive equipment is shared by all the members, which gives everybody an opportunity to turn their ideas into inventions.
In a makerspace, expensive machines and tools are shared among all members, which means everyone has a chance to turn their creativity into inventions.

patterns: 非限定關係子句（, which 指前面整句）

questions.stem: 然而，它們的會員費近年來不斷上漲，迫使那些負擔不起的人放棄自己的發明夢。
questions.answer: However, their membership fees have kept rising in recent years, forcing those who can't afford them to give up their dreams of inventing.
accepted_answers: However, in recent years their membership fees have been rising steadily, forcing those who cannot afford them to give up their dreams of becoming inventors.
However, the membership fees of these spaces have continued to rise in recent years, forcing people who cannot afford them to abandon their dreams of inventing things.

patterns: 句尾分詞片語表結果（, forcing …）

1.explanation_zh: 「在創客空間裡」用 In a makerspace（或複數 In makerspaces）。「昂貴的設備由所有會員共用」中文沒有「被」字，但設備是被使用的一方，英文用被動 expensive equipment is shared by all members；equipment 不可數，動詞用 is。「這讓人人都有機會…」的「這」指前面整件事，用非限定關係子句 , which gives everyone a chance to …（也可寫 which allows everyone to …、which means everyone has a chance to …）。「把創意變成發明」用 turn A into B：turn creative ideas into inventions。
1.strategy_zh: 中文沒有「被」但主詞是被動的一方 → be + p.p.；「…，這讓／這使得…」→ , which + V …（which 指前面整句）。
hints: 切成四段：在創客空間裡，昂貴的設備／由所有會員共用／這讓人人都有機會／把創意變成發明
標的詞彙：expensive（昂貴的）、equipment（設備）、share（共用）、member（會員）、chance（機會）、turn … into（把…變成）、idea（創意，也可用 creativity）、invention（發明）
句型框架：In a makerspace, S + is shared by …, which gives everyone a chance to turn A into B

2.explanation_zh: 「然而」用 However 承接上一句「人人都有機會」，轉到現實的困難；「它們」指創客空間，所有格用 their。「近年來不斷上漲」從過去持續到現在，用現在完成式 have kept rising／have been rising in recent years（價格上漲用不及物的 rise，不是 raise）。「迫使…」沒有自己的主詞，是前面「會員費上漲」造成的結果，用句尾分詞 , forcing + 受詞 + to V（寫 , which has forced … 文法也對，但這一句的標的句型是句尾分詞）。「那些負擔不起的人」寫成 those who cannot afford them（them 指會員費）。「放棄自己的發明夢」是 give up their dreams of inventing（或 of becoming inventors）。
evidence: 迫使那些負擔不起的人
2.strategy_zh: 「…，迫使／造成…」接在逗號後沒有主詞 → 句尾分詞 forcing／causing …；「那些…的人」→ those who + V。
hints: 切成四段：然而，它們的會員費／近年來不斷上漲／迫使那些負擔不起的人／放棄自己的發明夢
標的詞彙：membership（會員）、fee（費用）、rise（上漲）、recent（近來的）、force（迫使）、afford（負擔得起）、give up（放棄）、dream（夢想）、invent（發明）
句型框架：However, S + have kept rising in recent years, forcing those who cannot afford them + to give up …

In a makerspace, expensive machines and tools are shared among all members, which means everyone has a chance to turn their creativity into inventions.

bonus.text: So expensive is the equipment in a makerspace that it is shared by all members, giving everyone a chance to turn creative ideas into inventions.

traps.literal_error: However, their membership fees keep rise in recent years, …
traps.explanation_zh: 「近年來不斷…」是從過去延續到現在的變化，英文用現在完成式 have kept rising／have been rising；keep 後面接動名詞，價格上漲用不及物的 rise。

traps.literal_error: … forcing those who cannot afford them to give up their invent dreams.
traps.explanation_zh: 「發明夢」是濃縮的複合概念，英文要說清楚是「想發明東西的夢想」：dreams of inventing 或 dreams of becoming inventors。

bonus.text: Not only have their membership fees kept rising in recent years, but those who cannot afford them have also been forced to give up their dreams of inventing.
bonus.explanation_zh: Not only 放句首要倒裝（have + 主詞 + p.p.），強調「不但…而且…」。倒裝只是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

2.restructuring_zh: 「迫使那些負擔不起的人…」接在逗號後沒有主詞，是前面「會員費上漲」造成的結果，英文不另起一句，用句尾分詞 , forcing + 受詞 + to V；「那些負擔不起的人」修飾語在前，英文改成 those who cannot afford them；「發明夢」要展開成 dreams of inventing。

1.translation: In a makerspace, expensive equipment is shared by all the members, which gives everyone a chance to turn their creative ideas into inventions.
1.explanation_zh: 「由所有會員共用」中文是被動語意，用 is shared by all the members；「這讓人人都有機會」承接前句用 , which gives everyone a chance to；「把創意變成發明」用 turn A into B；equipment 不可數，不加 s。

2.translation: However, their membership fees have been rising steadily in recent years, forcing those who cannot afford them to give up their dreams of inventing.
2.explanation_zh: 「近年來不斷上漲」用現在完成進行式 have been rising steadily（也可 have kept rising）；「迫使…」是上漲造成的結果，用句尾分詞 forcing… 表結果；「那些負擔不起的人」用 those who cannot afford them；「發明夢」譯 dreams of inventing（也可 dreams of becoming inventors）。

issues_zh: 第 2 部分「近年來不斷上漲」本身包含「近年來」，但可接受寫法收了 have kept rising、have been rising、have continued to rise 等完全沒有時間詞的寫法（原意是配合把 in recent years 移到句首、併進第 1 部分的寫法）；各部分獨立比對時，整句漏譯「近年來」（However, their membership fees have kept rising, forcing …）四個部分仍全部對上、拿滿分。建議在第 2 部分註明：沒有時間詞的寫法只有在第 1 部分已出現 in recent years 時才算，否則漏譯「近年來」扣這一部分。
同一部分又收了現在式 keep rising、keeps rising、is rising（不含時間詞），卻把 keep rising in recent years 列為常見錯誤：漏譯「近年來」反而比照譯（只是時態錯）更容易得分，誘因不一致。

problems: 第 2 題驗證者對4 部分切分有意見（warn）：第 2 部分「近年來不斷上漲」本身包含「近年來」，但可接受寫法收了 have kept rising、have been rising、have continued to rise 等完全沒有時間詞的寫法（原意是配合把 in recent

1.translation: In a makerspace, expensive equipment is shared by all members, which gives everyone a chance to turn their creative ideas into inventions.
1.explanation_zh: 「昂貴的設備由所有會員共用」中文有「由」字，自然用被動語態 is shared by all members。「這讓人人都有機會」用 which gives everyone a chance，which 指前面整件事。「把創意變成發明」用 turn ... into ...，creative ideas 對應「創意」。這是一般性的描述，所以用現在式。

2.translation: However, their membership fees have kept rising in recent years, forcing those who cannot afford them to give up their dream of inventing.
2.explanation_zh: 「近年來不斷上漲」用 in recent years 搭配現在完成式 have kept rising（持續到現在的狀態）。「迫使……放棄」用現在分詞 forcing ... to give up 表結果。「那些負擔不起的人」用 those who cannot afford them（them 指 fees）。「發明夢」譯成 their dream of inventing，也可以寫 of becoming inventors，兩種意思略有差異，所以信心給 medium。另外句中的「它們」在這一句單獨看時指涉不明，我依上一句判斷是指創客空間（makerspaces），所以用 their membership fees。

status_reason: 判定者人工檢查退回（record_verification 判 verified；盲譯 A 已對第 2 句切分給 warn）：第 2 句第 2 部分「近年來不斷上漲」的 accepted 收了 keep rising、keeps rising、are rising、is rising、continue to rise 等 11 種現在式寫法，以及 have kept rising、have been rising 等不含時間詞的寫法，卻把 keep rising in recent years 列為常見錯誤（時態錯）。第 1 部分可放 in recent years 時，keep rising 正好組成評分規準自己判錯的寫法；第 1 部分不放時，整句漏譯「近年來」。兩種情況都四個部分全拿，可接受寫法和常見錯誤自相矛盾，漏譯的分數反而比照譯但時態錯還高。重生後仍不過，停在 rejected。
